not_automated: BUG-650 (Esc clearing the stored pit invert records): the Pit Schedule levels are not compared before and after (the schedule may be computed from the plan texts, so equal cells would not prove the stored records).
BUG-103, BUG-137 and BUG-139 (CDWT tanks) and CDSOURCE are not driven.
